_classes.name: metes-and-bounds revision of an earlier alienation act stored with no record (changed place of an existing local power)
_classes.rule: signed/*.json entries whose title or act_clause matches /metes and bounds|description of (the )?(parkland|lands?)/i AND /amend chapter/i, with zero records in duties/*.json + powers/*.json for that matter_id
_classes.note: db_matches counts LAWS (no obligation_ids exist; these are misses). Whether a re-drawn parcel is an 'added place' under prompt rule 56 needs an orchestrator call.

_classes.name: act clause 'shall be deemed to repeal therewith' wording not parsed to expires_rule with_referenced_section (Oct 16 decision)
_classes.rule: effective_dates/*.json raw_clause =~ /deemed to repeal therewith/i AND expires_rule is null (the parser catches 'deemed repealed therewith' and 'deemed to be repealed therewith' but 0 of 11 'deemed to repeal therewith')
_classes.note: 22 stored records across 11 laws. Broader: 102 more laws say 'deemed repealed therewith' with expires_rule null too (rule /deemed (to )?(be )?repeal(ed)? therewith/ + null = 118 laws, 129 records); not checked whether those are section-scoped by design.

_classes.name: retroactive clause 'deemed to have been in full force on and after DATE' (no 'and effect') leaves retroactive_to null
_classes.rule: effective_dates/*.json raw_clause =~ /deemed to have been in full force on and after/i AND retroactive_to is null
_classes.note: narrow rule hits 1 law (2019-A7634, 0 stored records). Broad rule /deemed to have been in (full )?force (and effect )?(on and after|from and after|since|on|from)/ with retroactive_to null hits 85 laws / 127 records, a mix of section-scoped clauses (by design) and real gaps ('on or after April 1, 2012' in 2011-S6584; 'if ... after June 30, 2021' in 2021-S6606). Effective date itself is unaffected.
